$comment: Mow Town tuning (everything gameplay lives here, not in code). Distances in world units; the grass grid is `cell` units per cell. grass: vegetation types — resistance = cutting power needed (a tool 1 below cuts it slowly, further below not at all), value = clippings per cell, height/color = uncut look, cutColor = the mowed stub. tools: the equipment path (index 0 = what the player starts with) — width = cutting width, speed = walking speed, power = cutting power, capacity = clippings the container holds, size/color = the placeholder cube. upgrades: repeatable levels on top of the tool, on the shop's GEAR tab (capacity: +clippings) or BOOSTS tab (speed +share, money +share of every sale, width +units, blades +share of chewing speed on tough grass); level n costs basePrice x growth^n. boostsUnlockToolLevel: the BOOSTS tab opens with this mower. Tools with `ride` are driven: the tractor (its look, seat, exhaust and smoke: `tractor`, edited in the editor) tinted with the tool colour and scaled by `rideScale`, mounted on entering a section not restored yet. clippingPrice: money per clipping when sold. The town's layout (sections = districts, their grass mix, bonus, stations, separators; props; pavements) is levels/town.json, edited in the editor (npm run editor).
